BYM4: Kari pura = holding him to be perfect, holding him to be unerring. Bhukh = the hunger of Maya. Meri = the sense of mine-ness toward Maya. Jai lahi = it is removed.
they, holding their own Guru to be unerring, go on doing the service he has enjoined, (by the grace of which, from within their minds) the hunger of Maya is removed.
He serves the Perfect True Guru, and his hunger and self-conceit are eliminated.
With the hands, he serves the Perfectly, True Guru and his hunger of self-hood is eliminated.
They serve the perfect Satiguru with their hands, by which (meri) mine-ness and (bhukh) desire may be removed.
RX02: Sabh = all. Khai = eats (spiritual food). Ghaneri = much humanity.
All the hunger of Maya of those who take the Guru's shelter is removed, and in their company much other humanity too eats the spiritual food of the Nam's simran.
The hunger of the Gursikh is totally eliminated; indeed, many others are satisfied through them.
Goes all the appetite of the Sikhs of the Guru. Rather, other feed themselves in their wake.
All the hunger of the Gursikhs has departed; behind those Gursikhs much other creation eats — that is to say, by the satsang their hunger is removed.
RXRX: Hari punnu = the good seed of the Nam's simran. Toti = lack, shortfall. Keri = of. Punn keri = of the good deed ||3||
O servant Nanak! Those men who sow the good seed of the simran of the Hari-Nam (in the field of their own heart), within them there is never any lack of this good deed. ||3||
Servant Nanak has planted the Seed of the Lord's Goodness; this Goodness of the Lord shall never be exhausted. ||3||
Servant Nanak has sown the virtue of God's Name and again, the virtue of the God's Name exhausts not.

Sri Guru Ji says: that servant who has sown the merit which is the Hari Nam in the soil of the heart — that is to say, has repeated or held it — to him, by the merit of repeating the Hari Nam, there is never any (toti) shortfall of any thing at all. ||3||
CQKF: Mani = in the mind. Vadhaia = joys, spiritual uplift, ascendancy.
Those Gursikhs who have had the darshan of the beloved Guru — in their mind there stays always an ascendant spirit.
The minds of the Gursikhs rejoice, because they have seen my True Guru, O Lord King.
Rejoicing are in the mind of the Guru-Sikhs, who have seen my True Guru, O Lord, the King.
O Ram Raje! Those who have seen my Satiguru, in the mind of those Guru's Sikhs there are congratulations at all times.
8TZC: Jinh = those who have. Gal = talk, mention. So = that man. Mitha = dear.
If any man comes and recites the talk of Parmatma's praise, then that man begins to seem dear to the Gursikhs.
If someone recites to them the story of the Lord's Name, it seems so sweet to the mind of those Gursikhs.
If some one recites to them the discourse of God's Name, he seems sweet to the mind of the Guru's disciples.
Whoever makes and recites the discourse of the Hari Nam, he seems sweet in the mind of the Gursikhs.
W3S3: Painhaiahi = robes of honour are given, they are honoured {present tense, passive voice, third person, plural}. Tutha = became pleased.
Those Gursikhs with whom the beloved Satiguru is pleased receive honour and regard in Parmatma's court.
The Gursikhs are robed in honor in the Court of the Lord; my True Guru is very pleased with them.
The Sikhs of the Guru, with whom my True Guru is mightily pleased are robed in God's court.
Those Gursikhs with whom my Satigur has been (tutha) pleased, to those Gursikhs a robe of honour is (painaiahi) put on in Hari's court — the sense being, they are treated with distinction.
3G4A: Nanaku = Nanak (says). Vutha = came to dwell ||4||12||19||
Nanak says — those Gursikhs become the very form of Parmatma; Parmatma stays for ever dwelling within their mind. ||4||12||19||
Servant Nanak has become the Lord, Har, Har; the Lord, Har, Har, abides within his mind. ||4||12||19||
Nanak, the Lord's servant, within whose mind God's Name abides, has become the Lord God Himself.
Sri Guru Ji says: that Gursikh in whose mind the Hari Hari Nam has (vutha) come to dwell, he, having (hari) renounced craving, has become the form of Hari. ||4||12||19||
AHP7: Jinha bhetia = those who took shelter. Drirhavai = makes firm within the heart.
Those men who have taken hold of the beloved Guru's hem — the Guru makes Parmatma's Nam firm within their heart.
Those who meet my Perfect True Guru - He implants within them the Name of the Lord, the Lord King.
They who meet my perfect, True Guru, within them, he establishes the Name of God, O Lord, the King.
Those to whom my perfect Satiguru has been met, to them he makes firm the Nam of Hari Ram Raje.
W8BH: Tis ki = of that (man). Trisna = thirst. Jo = which man.
That man who remembers Parmatma's Nam — all his hunger and thirst for Maya is removed.
Those who meditate on the Lord's Name have all of their desire and hunger removed.
They, who meditate on God's Name have all their desires and hungers removed.
Those who repeat the Hari Nam, all their hunger in the form of trishna is removed.
JRDL: Jo dhiaide = those men who remember. Tinh nerhi = near them.
Those men who always remember Parmatma's Nam, the jam does not come near them (spiritual death cannot exert its influence upon them).
Those who meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - the Messenger of Death cannot even approach them.
They, who contemplate over the Name of the Lord Master, near them comes not the death's courier.
Those who meditate upon the Hari Hari Nam, near them the jam does not come.
B0LD: Kari = may He do, He does. Nami = in the Nam (having joined). Taravai = He carries across ||1||
O servant Nanak! He upon whom Parmatma shows mercy repeats His Nam always, and Parmatma, joining him to His own Nam, carries him across (the world-ocean). ||1||
O Lord, shower Your Mercy upon servant Nanak, that he may ever chant the Name of the Lord; through the Name of the Lord, he is saved. ||1||
O God, show mercy to slave Nanak, who ever remembers God's Name and who with God's Name is saved.
Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! Show mercy upon us servants, by which we may daily repeat Your Hari Nam, and by the Hari Nam may (taravai) carry other seekers too across the ocean of the world. ||1||
5F4S: Gurmukhi = by way of the Guru. Bighanu = obstacle. Sad = always. Purakhu = the great being, the one possessed of capability.
Those men who, taking the Guru's shelter, remember Parmatma's Nam — no obstacle (of the vices and the rest) comes again in their journey of life.
Those who, as Gurmukh, meditate on the Naam, meet no obstacles in their path, O Lord King.
They, who, through the Guru, remember the Name, no more meet obstacle, in the way.
Those who have meditated upon the Nam of Ram Raje by way of the Gurus, to them no obstacle of any kind comes again.
61R0: Puje = does honour. Sabhu koi = every being.
Those men who (having made their own life pure) win the pleasure of the Guru possessed of capability — every being does them honour and regard.
Those who are pleasing to the almighty True Guru are worshipped by everyone.
They, who propitiate their potent True Guru, them worships the whole world.
Those who have won over and pleased the Satigur Purakh — everyone, that is to say the whole world, performs their worship.
DJXD: Those men who perform the seva enjoined by the beloved Guru (who take the Guru's support) obtain spiritual bliss for ever.
Those who serve their Beloved True Guru obtain eternal peace.
They, who serve their beloved True Guru, ever obtain peace.
Those who have served the beloved Satigur, to them happiness has come for all time.
3MWN: Nanaku = Nanak (says). Bhetia = took shelter, took hold of the hem. Soi = He Himself ||2||
Nanak (says) — those men who take hold of the Guru's hem, to them Parmatma comes and is met of Himself. ||2||
Those who meet the True Guru, O Nanak - the Lord Himself meets them. ||2||
Those who meet Nanak, the True Guru, them, He, the Lord meets.
Sri Guru Ji says: those to whom the Satiguru has been met, to them that Hari has been met. ||2||
8QNY: Antari = in the heart. Gurmukhi = by walking the road the Guru showed. Rakhanhara = possessed of the power to save.
Those men within whose heart the love of Parmatma arises by walking the road the Guru showed — Parmatma, who has the power to save, (saves them from the vices).
Those Gurmukhs, who are filled with His Love, have the Lord as their Saving Grace, O Lord King.
The Guru-wards, within whose mind is the Lord's love, their saviour is God Master, the Monarch.
Those gurmukhs within whom is the love of Hari Ram Raje, of them Hari is the protector.
BY0B: Kia kare = what can he do? He cannot do it (because no vice remains in them that could be reviled).
Those men to whom Parmatma's Nam begins to seem dear — no one can slander them, because no blameworthy fault remains in their life at all.
How can anyone slander them? The Lord's Name is dear to them.
How can any one slander them, to whom God's Name is dear?
Those to whom the Hari-Nam seems dear — what will anyone's slander of them do? The sense being, their slanderer can spoil nothing at all.
JRFY: Seti = with. Mania = became satisfied, grew accustomed. Dusat = evil men. Jhakh = vain effort.
So, those whose mind grows accustomed to Parmatma — evil men beat about in vain (to defame them).
Those whose minds are in harmony with the Lord - all their enemies attack them in vain.
They, whose soul is reconciled (intimate) with God, all the miscreants, traduce them in vain.

Those whose mind has been satisfied with Hari — that is to say, has become established in Hari — all the wicked have beaten about in vain to make obstruction in their work, but nothing at all comes of anyone's saying.
9GDB: O servant Nanak! (Say —) Those men who remember the Hari-Nam, Hari who has the power to save (saves them from the vices). ||3||
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord Protector. ||3||
Servant Nanak has contemplated upon the Name of God, who is the Saviour of all.
Sri Guru Ji says: those who have meditated upon the Nam, of them Hari has become the protector. ||3||
W8FD: Jugu jugu = in every age {see 'Gurbani Viakaran'}. Upaia = goes on creating. Paij = honour. Dei = having given.
Parmatma creates bhagats in every single age, and (in times of hardship) has gone on keeping their honour.
In each and every age, He creates His devotees and preserves their honor, O Lord King.
In every age God created His saints and preserved their honour.
O Hari Ram Raje! You have brought forth bhagats in all four ages, and again You have gone on keeping the bhagats' pledge.
90T1: (As, for instance, Prahilad's cruel father) the wicked Harnakhas Parmatma (in the end) slew, and rescued (His own bhagat) Prahilad safe and sound (from the torments given by his father).
The Lord killed the wicked Harnaakhash, and saved Prahlaad.
Wicked Harnakhsh, the Lord killed and saved Prehlad.
O Hari! You slew the wicked Harnakhyash, and again You ferried Prahilad across the ocean of the world.
DKY1: Mukhi laia = took to His own face, gave honour and regard, bestowed dignity. Aisa = of such capability.
(As, for instance,) to the slanderers and the (caste-) proud (who pushed him from the temple, Parmatma) turned His back, and gave His darshan to (His own bhagat) Namdev.
He turned his back on the egotists and slanderers, and showed His Face to Naam Dayv.
On the egotists and slanderers, the Lord turned His back and to Namdev, He showed His face (affection).
Turning His back on the proud, slandering brahmans, O Hari, You turned the temple around for Namdev and took him to Your own face.
UXJK: O servant Nanak! Whatever man performs the seva and bhagti of a Parmatma of such capability, Parmatma in the end rescues him (from all the torments inflicted by ill-wishers). ||4||13||20||
Servant Nanak has so served the Lord, that He will deliver him in the end. ||4||13||20||
Servant Nanak has so served His God, that He will deliver him in the end.

Sri Guru Ji says: O Hari! We servants have served such a You — that in the end You may release us from sorrows on every side. ||4||13||20|| ☬ Making his love manifest, he gives the updesh addressed to his own mind:
0L52: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl, Chhant, Fifth House:
0PLD: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace he is obtained.
9C6L: O my dear beloved stranger mind, please come home!
O my darling stranger soul, come you into your own home.
2PR1: Meet with the Lord-Guru, O my dear beloved, and He will dwell in the home of your self.
My Guru, cause me to meet my dear God, that He, the Lord, may abide within my home.
N9GK: Revel in His Love, O my dear beloved, as the Lord bestows His Mercy.
If God shows mercy, O my dear, you shall make merry in His love.
B886: As Guru Nanak is pleased, O my dear beloved, we are united with the Lord. ||1||
When Guru Nanak is pleased, my dear, he unites man with God.
S8VM: I have not tasted divine love, O my dear beloved, within my heart.
I have not heartily tasted the love of my Lord, the Beloved.
YMH6: The mind's desires are not quenched, O my dear beloved, but I still hold out hope.
The thirst of my heart has not been quenched, O Beloved, and I ever cherish hope to see You.
ZG06: Youth is passing away, O my dear beloved, and death is stealing away the breath of life.
Each day youth is passing away, my Beloved, and death is stealing away my breath.
FMCP: The virtuous bride realizes the good fortune of her destiny, O my dear beloved; O Nanak, she enshrines the Lord within her heart. ||2||
Fortunate and chaste is the wife, O Nanak, who claps God, her Beloved to her heart.

NPML: My eyes are drenched with the Love of my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, like the song-bird with the rain drop.
My eyes are imbued with the love of my Beloved, like those of the pied-cuckoo for rain drop, o dear.
XFKQ: My mind is cooled and soothed, O my dear beloved, by drinking in the rain drops of the Lord.
My soul is cooled by drinking the rain drops of God, O dear.
CDNK: Separation from my Lord keeps my body awake, O my dear beloved; I cannot sleep at all.
Separation from my Love keeps my body awake, O dear, and by no means I can go to sleep.
F7J5: Nanak has found the Lord, the True Friend, O my dear beloved, by loving the Guru. ||3||
By loving the Guru, Nanak has found God, the friend, O dear
S00U: In the month of Chayt, O my dear beloved, the pleasant season of spring begins.
In the month of Chetar, my dear, begins the pleasant season of spring.
J7GT: But without my Husband Lord, O my dear beloved, my courtyard is filled with dust.
But without my spouse, O dear, the dust is flying in the court-yard of my mind.
T92S: But my sad mind is still hopeful, O my dear beloved; my eyes are both fixed upon Him.
There is hope still in my sad heart and my eyes, both are fixed on Him, my Beloved.
JKUV: Beholding the Guru, Nanak is filled with wondrous joy, like a child, gazing upon his mother. ||4||
But now, on seeing the Guru, Nanak is over-joyed as a child, on beholding its mother, O dear.
WQZR: The True Guru has preached the sermon of the Lord, O my dear beloved.
My dear True Guru has recited to me the discourses and tales of God.
WSXV: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, O my dear beloved, who has united me with the Lord.
I am a sacrifice to my beloved Guru, who has united me with God.
TYQS: The Lord has fulfilled all my hopes, O my dear beloved; I have obtained the fruits of my heart's desires.
God has fulfilled all my hopes, O dear, and I have obtained the fruit, my mind desired.
FA3D: When the Lord is pleased, O my dear beloved, servant Nanak is absorbed into the Naam. ||5||
When the Lord is pleased, O my dear, slave Nanak is absorbed in His Name.
B7L8: Without the Beloved Lord, there is no play of love.
Without my Beloved God, I shall not have love play.
0BM5: How can I find the Guru? Grasping hold of Him, I behold my Beloved.
How shall I find the Guru, by clinging to whom I can see my Beloved?
B0X8: O Lord, O Great Giver, let me meet the Guru; as Gurmukh, may I merge with You.
O Bounteous God, cause me to meet the Supreme Guru, as through the Guru alone, I can unite with You.
AUT2: Nanak has found the Guru, O my dear beloved; such was the destiny inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||14||21||
Nanak has obtained the Guru, O dear, because such was the primal writ on his forehead.
MDU5: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
R0Q3: Raag Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, First House:
0HMR: Joy - great joy! I have seen the Lord God!
Joy! great joy! He, the Lord Master, I have seen.
ZM5D: Tasted - I have tasted the sweet essence of the Lord.
Tasted, tasted have I the sweet elixir of the Lord God.
FAVN: The sweet essence of the Lord has rained down in my mind; by the pleasure of the True Guru, I have attained peaceful ease.
God's sweet elixir has rained in my mind, and through True Guru's pleasure, I have attained composure.
Y4WX: I have come to dwell in the home of my own self, and I sing the songs of joy; the five villains have fled.
My home has been peopled and I sing The songs of rejoicing, as those five villains (passions) have fled.
L90E: I am soothed and satisfied with the Ambrosial Bani of His Word; the friendly Saint is my advocate.
I am pacified and sated with the ambrosial Gurbani, and the friendly Saint- Guru is my intercessor.
BLQY: Says Nanak, my mind is in harmony with the Lord; I have seen God with my eyes. ||1||
Says Nanak, my soul is domesticated (at one) with God. He, the Lord, I have seen with my eyes.
ABN8: Adorned - adorned are my beauteous gates, O Lord.
Adorned! adorned are my beauteous gates, O my Omnipresent Lord.
UZ8F: Guests - my guests are the Beloved Saints, O Lord.
Guests, mine guests are the dear saints, O my Lord.
0VYN: The Beloved Saints have resolved my affairs; I humbly bowed to them, and committed myself to their service.
The dear saints adjusted my affairs, when I did them homage and took to their service.
NJC6: He Himself is the groom's party, and He Himself the bride's party; He Himself is the Lord and Master; He Himself is the Divine Lord.
God Himself is the groom's man, Himself the bride's man, Himself the Master and Himself the marriage-god.
XNTW: He Himself resolves His own affairs; He Himself sustains the Universe.
His affair, the Lord Himself arranges and he himself sustains the universe.
JL8J: Says Nanak, my Bridegroom is sitting in my home; the gates of my body are beautifully adorned. ||2||
Says Nanak, the Bridegroom is sitting in my home, so adorned look my beautiful gates.
SBUF: The nine treasures - the nine treasures come into my home, Lord.
The nine treasures, the nine treasures, then enter my home.
9TKZ: Everything - I obtain everything, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Everything, everything do I obtain By meditating on the Lord's Name.
A89J: Meditating on the Naam, the Lord of the Universe becomes one's eternal companion, and he dwells in peaceful ease.
By remembering the Name with equipoise and devotion, the Lord of the world becomes man's helper, for aye.
AAZR: His calculations are ended, his wanderings cease, and his mind is no longer afflicted with anxiety.
His calculation is ended, his wandering ceases and anxiety never clings to his mind.
JWED: When the Lord of the Universe reveals Himself, and the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates, the drama of wondrous splendor is enacted.
When the Lord becomes manifest, spontaneous music plays and a scene of wondrous splendour is enacted.
45F7: Says Nanak, when my Husband Lord is with me, I obtain the nine treasures. ||3||
Says Nanak, when the Beloved is with me, then, do I obtain the nine treasures.
KF8G: Over-joyed - over-joyed are all my brothers and friends.
Over-joyed, over-joyed became all my brothers and friends.

MZUM: Meeting the Guru, I have won the most arduous battle in the arena of life.
By meeting the Guru, I have won the very toilsome (hard) battle of the arena.
GG6S: Meeting the Guru, I am victorious; praising the Lord, Har, Har, the walls of the fortress of doubt have been destroyed.
On meeting the Guru, I repeated God's Name, razed to the ground the walls of the castle of doubt, and obtained the victory.
V14Q: I have obtained the wealth of so many treasures; the Lord Himself has stood by my side.
I obtained the wealth of many treasures and the Lord Himself stood by to assist me.
5C97: He is the man of spiritual wisdom, and he is the leader, whom God has made His own.
That man is the sublime divine and he the chief, whom the Lord has made His own.
UN3X: Says Nanak, when the Lord and Master is on my side, then my brothers and friends rejoice. ||4||1||
Says Nanak, when the Lord is on my side, then my brothers and friends rejoice.
48K7: Inexpressible is the sermon of the inexpressible Lord; it cannot be known at all.
Indescribable is the sermon of the Ineffable Lord Master. It cannot be knows even a little.
HANZ: The demi-gods, mortal beings, angels and silent sages express it in their peaceful poise.
The demigods, man, angelic persons and the silent sages have serenely expressed it.
KTJT: In their poise, they recite the Ambrosial Bani of the Lord's Word; they embrace love for the Lord's Lotus Feet.
In equipoise they recite the ambrosial Gurbani and embrace love for Lord's louts feet.
M820: Meditating on the One incomprehensible and immaculate Lord, they obtain the fruits of their heart's desires.
By meditating on the one incomprehensible and Immaculate Lord, they obtain their heart. desired boons.
CZ62: Renouncing self-conceit, emotional attachment, corruption and duality, their light merges into the Light.
Forsaking self-conceit, worldly love, sin and duality, the mortal's light merges into the supreme light.
KNZL: Prays Nanak, by Guru's Grace, one enjoys the Lord's Love forever. ||1||
Prays Nanak, by Guru's grace man ever enjoys God's love.
G2C2: The Lord's Saints - the Lord's Saints are my friends, my best friends and helpers.
God's saints, God's saints alone are my friends, intimates and helpers.
SA82: By great good fortune, by great good fortune, I have obtained the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
By the greatest good luck, the greatest good luck I have obtained the society of saints.
THX2: By great good fortune, I obtained it, and I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; my pains and sufferings have been taken away.
Through good destiny I have obtained the saints' guild and have meditated on the Name, and my anguish and affliction are removed.
AYB6: I have grasped the Guru's Feet, and my doubts and fears are gone. He Himself has erased my self-conceit.
I have clung to Guru's feet and my doubt and dread have fled. The Lord Himself has effaced my self-conceit.
990Y: Granting His Grace, God has united me with Himself; no longer do I suffer the pains of separation, and I shall not have to go anywhere.
Showering His benediction, the Lord has united me with His ownself, and now I shall neither suffer separation, nor go anywhere.
9UAW: Prays Nanak, I am forever Your slave, Lord; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||
Supplicates Nanak, O God, I am Your slave and I ever seek Yours protection.
GLYX: The Lord's Gate - at the Lord's Gate, Your beloved devotees look beautiful.
At Your gate, your gate, O Lord God, Yours loved devotees look dignified.
E3XH: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, again and again a sacrifice to them.
O Lord, I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice and ever a sacrifice to them.
NENW: I am forever a sacrifice, and I humbly bow to them; meeting them, I know God.
I make obeisance and am ever devoted to them, by meeting whom I have known the Lord.
YFEC: The Perfect and All-powerful Lord, the Architect of Destiny, is contained in each and every heart, everywhere.
The Perfect and Omnipotent Creator is contained in every heart and all the places.
0NP8: Meeting the Perfect Guru, we meditate on the Naam, and do not lose this life in the gamble.
Meeting the Perfect Guru, he who meditates on the Name, loses not his life in a gamble.
8AYZ: Prays Nanak, I seek Your Sanctuary; please, shower Your Mercy upon me, and protect me. ||3||
Supplicates Nanak, O Lord, I have sought Your protection, show mercy and save me.
GVND: Innumerable - innumerable are Your Glorious Virtues; how many of them can I sing?
Numberless, numberless are Yours merits, O Lord. How many of them can I sing?
JJME: The dust of Your feet, of Your feet, I have obtained, by great good fortune.
The dust of Your feet, Your feet my Master, I have obtained through the greatest good destiny.
PQ6F: Bathing in the Lord's dust, my filth has been washed away, and the pains of birth and death have departed.
Bathing in God's dust, filth is washed off and departs the Pain of birth and death.
0JJ6: Inwardly and outwardly, the Transcendent Lord God is ever-present, always with us.
Within and without, the Transcendent Lord Master is ever present with the mortal.
NZHT: Suffering departs, and there is peace; singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, one is not consigned to reincarnation again.
By singing Lord's praise, peace ensues, pain ends, and man enters not existences (births), again.
F968: Prays Nanak, in the Guru's Sanctuary, one swims across, and is pleasing to God. ||4||2||
Prays Nanak, in Guru's refuge, man swims across and becomes pleasing to his Lord.
GK3P: Aasaa, Chhant, Fifth Mehl, Fourth House:
9F3G: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God By the True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
DTZ4: My mind is pierced by the Lord's Lotus Feet; He alone is sweet to my mind, the Lord King.
With God's lotus feet my mind is pierced through and none other than Lord, the King, is sweet to me.
JGR6: Joining the Society of the Saints, I meditate on the Lord in adoration; I behold the Lord King in each and every heart.
Meeting the society of saints, I meditate on God and see the Sovereign Lord in all the hearts.
LMR2: I behold the Lord in each and every heart, and the Ambrosial Nectar rains down upon me; the pains of birth and death are gone.
I see God in every heart and Lord's Nectar rains on me, and my pain of birth and death has fled.
DCPX: Singing the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of virtue, all my pains are erased, and the knot of ego has been untied.
By singing the praises of God, the treasure of merits, my sorrow is all effaced, and my knot of pride is loosened.

3SDK: My Beloved shall not leave me to go anywhere - this is His natural way; my mind is imbued with the lasting color of the Lord's Love.
By His natural disposition, my Beloved, leaving me, goes no where and my soul has adopted the fast colour of madder.
VLJQ: The Lotus Feet of the Lord have pierced Nanak's mind, and now, nothing else seems sweet to him. ||1||
The Lord's louts feet have pierced Nanak's mind, and now nothing else seems sweet to him.
4VMX: Just like the fish which revels in water, I am intoxicated with the sublime essence of the Lord, my Lord King.
As the fish cherishes water, so am I intoxicated with the Nectar of Lord master, the King.
L39P: The Perfect Guru has instructed me, and blessed me with salvation in my life; I love the Lord, my King.
The Perfect Guru has instructed me and I love my Lord; the King, who has blessed me with present salvation.
F6X0: The Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts, blesses me with salvation in my life; He Himself attaches me to His Love.
They, whom Lord, the Knower of hearts, attaches to His skirt, obtain salvation while, alive.
QJ6B: The Lord is the treasure of jewels, the perfect manifestation; He shall not forsake us to go anywhere else.
God is an invaluable wealth, and is manifest and fully contained among all, and forsaking them He goes not elsewhere,
CR0C: God, the Lord Master, is so accomplished, beauteous, and all-knowing; His gifts are never exhausted.
The Lord Master is accomplished, beauteous and sagacious (wise) and His bounties exhaust not.
AGGA: As the fish is enraptured by the water, so is Nanak intoxicated by the Lord. ||2||
The fish is satiated with water, and so in the Lord, Nanak is absorbed.
4M1D: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, the Lord, the Lord my King, is the Support of my breath of life.
As the pied-cuckoo craves for rain-drop, so Lord God, the King, is the support of my life.
7FA1: My Lord King is more beloved than all wealth, treasure, children, siblings and friends.
The Sovereign Lord to me is dearer than all the wealth, treasure, son, brother and friend.
5ZSA: The absolute Lord, the Primal Being, is more beloved than all; His condition cannot be known.
The detached Lord is dearer to me than all and His state none can comprehend.
GMWW: I shall never forget the Lord, for an instant, for a single breath; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I enjoy His Love.
I never forget God, even for a single breath and morsel, and under Guru's instruction I enjoy His love.
CVCX: The Primal Lord God is the Life of the Universe; His Saints drink in the Lord's sublime essence. Meditating on Him, doubts, attachments and pains are shaken off.
The perfect Master is the life of the universe and the saints quaff His Nectar, and meditating on Him, shake off their doubt, worldly love and distress.
2131: As the song-bird yearns for the rain-drop, so does Nanak love the Lord. ||3||
As the pied-cuckoo longs for rain-drop, so is the Lord dear to Nanak.
N9D5: Meeting the Lord, my Lord King, my desires are fulfilled.
By meeting with my Lord Master, the King, my desire is fulfilled.
RBVF: The walls of doubt have been torn down, meeting the Brave Guru, O Lord King.
The wall of doubt is razed by meeting the valiant Guru, O Lord the King.
08NZ: The Perfect Guru is obtained by perfect pre-ordained destiny; God is the Giver of all treasures - He is merciful to the meek.
The Perfect Guru is obtained through the eternal writ of God. Who is the Giver of all the treasure and is merciful to the meek.
1DES: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, is God, the most beautiful Guru, the Sustainer of the World.
In the beginning, the middle, the end is He alone, the Beauteous and great Lord, the World-Cherisher.
V0FF: The dust of the feet of the Holy purifies sinners, and brings great joy, bliss and ecstasy.
The dust of saints feet purifies the sinners and bestows immense joy, peace and happiness.
5L3X: The Lord, the Infinite Lord, has met with Nanak, and his desires are fulfilled. ||4||1||3||
The Omnipresent Lord God has met Nanak, and his desire is fulfilled.
LGQQ: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Sixth House:
8EQ0: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
5G4R: Those beings, to whom the Lord God shows His Mercy, meditate on the Lord, Har, Har.
They, to whom the Master becomes merciful, meditate on the Lord God.
K28V: O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord, meeting the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||
Meeting the society of saints, O Nanak, they embrace love for the Lord.
3U46: Just like water, which loves milk so much that it will not let it burn - O my mind, so love the Lord.
My soul, enshrine such love for God, as is the love of water for milk, which now allows not milk to burn.
7CP5: The bumble bee becomes enticed by the lotus, intoxicated by its fragrance, and does not leave it, even for a moment.
Now, intoxicated in the fragrance of the louts, the bumble bee becomes entangled and leaves it not even for a moment.
7Q46: Do not let up your love for the Lord, even for an instant; dedicate all your decorations and pleasures to Him.
Relax not a while your love for God and dedicate to Him all yours ornaments and enjoyments.
J971: Where painful cries are heard, and the Way of Death is shown, there, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not be afraid.
Where wailings are heard and Death's way is pointed, there by Virtues of the society of saints, you shall feel no fear.
LGHF: Sing the Kirtan, the Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and all sins and sorrows shall depart.
Sing you the praises and merits of God and all yours sins and sorrows shall depart.
ZUU8: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Lord, the Lord of the Universe, O mind, and enshrine love for the Lord; love the Lord this way in your mind. ||1||
Says Nanak, chant the songs of Lord God, O man, contract you love with God and in your mind bear God such an affection.
8RP2: As the fish loves the water, and is not content even for an instant outside it, O my mind, love the Lord in this way.
As a fish loves water and is composed not without it, even for a trice, so O mind, love you the Master.

214B: Like the song-bird, thirsting for the rain-drops, chirping each and every moment to the beautiful rain clouds.
As a pied-cuckoo, thirsty for rain drops, chirrups every moment "rain, O beautiful cloud".
VHSS: So love the Lord, and give to Him this mind of yours; totally focus your consciousness on the Lord.
So love you your God, give to Him this soul and thoroughly fix your attention on Lord, the killer of Mur demon.
BK99: Do not take pride in yourself, but seek the Sanctuary of the Lord, and make yourself a sacrifice to the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
Don't take pride, seek God's refuge and be a sacrifice to His vision.
58JZ: When the Guru is totally pleased, the separated soul-bride is re-united with her Husband Lord; she sends the message of her true love.
When the Guru is greatly pleased, the bride sends the massage of her true love and her parted Spouse comes and meets her.
AC6L: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Infinite Lord Master; O my mind, love Him and enshrine such love for Him. ||2||
Says Nanak, sing you the rhythm of the Infinite Lord, O my soul and love Him and enshrine you such an affection for Him.
RHRD: The chakvi bird is in love with the sun, and thinks of it constantly; her greatest longing is to behold the dawn.
The Sheldrake is in love with the sun, and thinks of it, She has great longing as to when she shall behold the sun.
8BL7: The cuckoo is in love with the mango tree, and sings so sweetly. O my mind, love the Lord in this way.
The cuckoo is in love with the mango, and sings sweetly. So do you love God, O my soul.
3AUH: Love the Lord, and do not take pride in yourself; everyone is a guest for a single night.
Love God and take not pride, as all are but guests of a single night.
A9P5: Now, why are you entangled in pleasures, and engrossed in emotional attachment? Naked we come, and naked we go.
Now, why are you involved in revelments and engrossed in worldly attachments? The mortal comes and goes naked.
MMCJ: Seek the eternal Sanctuary of the Holy and fall at their feet, and the attachments which you feel shall depart.
By seeking saints' shelter and falling at his Feet, the secular attachment, which you now feelest, shall depart and you shall becomes immortal.
LY9A: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the Merciful Lord God, and enshrine love for the Lord, O my mind; otherwise, how will you come to behold the dawn? ||3||
Says Nanak, sing you the hymns of the Merciful Master and enshrine affection for God, O man, otherwise how shall you see God, the Sun?
NZAU: Like the deer in the night, who hears the sound of the bell and gives his heart - O my mind, love the Lord in this way.
As the deer at night, hearing with his ears the sound of the bell, gives his heart, so love you the Lord, O man.
82MB: Like the wife, who is bound by love to her husband, and serves her beloved - like this, give your heart to the Beloved Lord.
As the wife, entangled in love of her husband, serves her darling, so give you this heart to your Beloved,
35T1: Give your heart to your Beloved Lord, and enjoy His bed, and enjoy all pleasure and bliss.
Give your heart to your Love and enjoy His bed (society). Thus shall you experience all joy and bliss.
L4VV: I have obtained my Husband Lord, and I am dyed in the deep crimson color of His Love; after such a long time, I have met my Friend.
I have obtained my love, assumed red colour and met my Friend (God) after a very long time.
CT7F: When the Guru became my advocate, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. No one else looks like my Beloved Husband Lord.
When the Guru became the intercessor, then I saw the Lord with my eyes. None else appears to me like my Beloved.
SVFH: Says Nanak, chant the Hymns of the merciful and fascinating Lord, O mind. Grasp the lotus feet of the Lord, and enshrine such love for Him in your mind. ||4||1||4||
Says Nanak, sing you the Chhant (hymns) of the compassionate and fascinating Lord. O man, grasp God's Feet and bear you Him such love in your mind.
XXF1: From forest to forest, I wandered searching; I am so tired of taking baths at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Of roaming and searching from forest to forest and having ablutions at holy places I have become very weary.
4PAS: O Nanak, when I met the Holy Saint, I found the Lord within my mind. ||1||
Nanak, When I met with the saints, I found my God within my mind.
31A4: Countless silent sages and innumerable ascetics seek Him;
Whom countless silent sages and so many penitents seek for;
XG3U: millions of Brahmas meditate and adore Him; the spiritual teachers meditate and chant His Name.
On whom million of Brahmas meditate and whose Name is uttered by the gnostics;
WRT7: Through chanting, deep meditation, strict and austere self-discipline, religious rituals, sincere worship, endless purifications and humble salutations,
Contemplation, austerity, equanimity, religious rites, worship, so many purifications,
LT0J: wandering all over the earth and bathing at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, people seek to meet the Pure Lord.
wandering over the earth, bathing at holies and obeisance are practiced by people to seek meeting the Pure Lord.
2WQ7: Mortals, forests, blades of grass, animals and birds all meditate on You.
Whom the men, forests, grass-blades, beasts and birds all meditate on;
HDMS: The Merciful Beloved Lord, the Lord of the Universe is found; O Nanak, joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, salvation is attained. ||1||
meeting the society of saints, O Nanak, salvation is attained and That compassionate and Beloved World-Lord is found.
3N85: Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiva, with matted hair
Millions of incarnations of Vishnu and Shiv, with matted-hair,
C9XU: yearn for You, O Merciful Lord; their minds and bodies are filled with infinite longing.
desire You, O Kind Lord, with endless longing of their mind and body.
R5EE: The Lord Master, the Lord of the Universe, is infinite and unapproachable; God is the all-pervading Lord of all.
Infinite and Inaccessible is Lord, the World-Sustainer, and He is the Omnipresent wealthy Master.
75GQ: The angels,the Siddhas,the beings of spiritual perfection,the heavenly heralds and celestial singers meditate on You. The Yakhsha demons,the guards of the divine treasures,and the Kinnars, the dancers of the god of wealth chant Your Glorious Praises.
The gods, perfect persons, heavenly heralds and celestial singers contemplate on You. The super gods and heavenly dancers utter Yours praises.
WUV2: Millions of Indras and countless gods and super-human beings meditate on the Lord Master and celebrate His Praises.
Myriads of Kings, gods and many super-human beings remember the Lord and hail Him.
D6DA: The Merciful Lord is the Master of the masterless, O Nanak; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved. ||2||
The Merciful Master is the Patron of the patronless and one is saved by joining the society of saints, O Nanak.
XR5T: Millions of gods and goddesses of wealth serve Him in so many ways.
Whom millions of goddesses and deities of wealth serve in diverse way.

2B40: The invisible and visible beings worship Him in adoration, along with wind and water, day and night.
Whom invisible and visible begins, wind, water, day and night worship.
8H3N: The stars, the moon and the sun meditate on Him; the earth and the sky sing to Him.
Whom remember the stars, the moon and the sun, and whose praise the earth and the sky sing.
L4AC: All the sources of creation, and all languages meditate on Him, forever and ever.
Whom all the sources of production and languages remember ever and ever.
HRK3: The Simritees, the Puraanas, the four Vedas and the six Shaastras meditate on Him.
On whom meditate the Simritis, the Puranas, the four Vedas and the six Shashatras.
VZDJ: He is the Purifier of sinners, the Lover of His Saints; O Nanak, He is met in the Society of the Saints. ||3||
That Lord, the Purifier of the sinners and the Lover of His saints, is met through the society of saints, O Nanak.
WCUS: As much as God has revealed to us, that much we can speak with our tongues.
As much as the Lord made known to me, that much does my tongue utter.
BB9C: Those unknown ones who serve You cannot be counted.
They, of whom I know not, serve You, and of them there cannot be a count.
WYJE: Imperishable, incalculable, and unfathomable is the Lord and Master; He is everywhere, inside and out.
Imperishable is the Lord and within and without, all over, He is.
ZFV5: We are all beggars, He is the One and only Giver; He is not far away, but is with us, ever-present.
We are all beggars, You alone are the Giver and You are not remote, rather are present and manifest.
A1F8: He is in the power of His devotees; those whose souls are united with Him - how can their praises be sung?
You are in the power of Yours devoted slaves and the mortals who meet You, their praise how can I recount?
2EFZ: May Nanak receive this gift and honor, of placing his head on the feet of the Holy Saints. ||4||2||5||
May Nanak obtain this boon and honour of placing his head on the saints feet.
9M8F: Make the effort, O very fortunate ones, and meditate on the Lord, the Lord King.
Make effort, you, very fortunate, and meditate on Lord God, the King.
CQBR: O Nanak, remembering Him in meditation, you shall obtain total peace, and your pains and troubles and doubts shall depart. ||1||
Nanak, by remembering Him, you shall have all the peace and your troubles, pains and doubts shall disappear.
557N: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe; don't be lazy.
Be not lazy in repeating the World-Lord's Name.
JALE: Meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall not have to go to the City of Death.
Meeting with the saints, man goes not to the Death-Courier's City.
GWWC: Pain, trouble and fear will not afflict you; meditating on the Naam, a lasting peace is found.
Meditating on The Name man is ever happy, and trouble, pain and fear cling to him not.
4FZZ: With each and every breath, worship the Lord in adoration; meditate on the Lord God in your mind and with your mouth.
With every breath, meditate you on the Lord God, and with Your mouth heartily remember the Master.
UXMA: O kind and compassionate Lord, O treasure of sublime essence, treasure of excellence, please link me to Your service.
O Kind and compassionate Lord, the Store of elixir and the Treasure of excellences, mercifully attach me to Yours service.
CQ5F: Prays Nanak: may I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and not be lazy in chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Prays Nanak, meditate you on God's Feet and be not indolent in repeating Lord's Name
X0CN: The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.
Purificator of the sinners is the pure Name of the Immaculate Lord.
TFWS: The darkness of doubt is removed by the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.
The salve of Guru's Divine knowledge. removes the darkness of doubt.
1YMA: By the healing ointment of the Guru's spiritual wisdom, one meets the Immaculate Lord God, who is totally pervading the water, the land and the sky.
By the salve of Guru's divine knowledge one perceives the Immaculate Lord, fully contained in water, land and sky.
3Z8J: If He dwells within the heart, for even an instant, sorrows are forgotten.
He, within whose mind the Lord abides even for a moment, his sorrow disappear.
A48Q: The wisdom of the all-powerful Lord and Master is incomprehensible; He is the Destroyer of the fears of all.
Perfect Lord's knowledge is incomprehensible. He is the Destroyer of the fear of all.
FFCY: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet. The Purifier of sinners is the Naam, the Pure Name of the Immaculate Lord. ||2||
Prays Nanak, I think of God's Feet. Purifier of the sinners is the pure Name of the Pure Lord.
PK2P: I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the Sustainer of the Universe, the treasure of grace.
I have grasped the protection of the merciful Lord, the treasure of grace.
SRGV: I take the support of Your lotus feet, and in the protection of Your Sanctuary, I attain perfection.
I have the support of Yours feet and in Your refuge lies my success, O Lord.
XV3L: The Lord's lotus feet are the cause of causes; the Lord Master saves even the sinners.
The Lord God's Feet are the cause of causes and by His grace, the Lord Master saves the sinners.
9XRH: So many are saved; they cross over the terrifying world-ocean, contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Good many are saved and cross the terrible world-ocean by contemplating on The Name
6443: In the beginning and in the end, countless are those who seek the Lord. I have heard that the Society of the Saints is the way to salvation.
In the beginning and the end, countless seek the Lord, I have heard that the society of saints is the way to emancipation.
Q98S: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet, and grasp the protection of the Lord of the Universe, the merciful, the ocean of kindness. ||3||
Says Nanak, meditate I on God's Feet (Name) and enter the sanctuary of the kind. Cherisher of the world, an ocean of compassion.
QV1L: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way.
God is the Lover of His saints and this is His self-made nature.
9ECU: Wherever the Saints worship the Lord in adoration, there He is revealed.
Wheresoever the saints invoke the Lord, there is He revealed.
5PNJ: God blends Himself with His devotees in His natural way, and resolves their affairs.
His saints the Lord spontaneously merges with Himself and adjusts their affairs.
RS68: In the ecstasy of the Lord's Praises, they obtain supreme joy, and forget all their sorrows.
In God's praise, they obtain peace and supreme bliss and forget all sorrows.

239Y: The brilliant flash of the One Lord is revealed to them - they behold Him in the ten directions.
The flash and light of the one Lord, they behold in ten directions.
5EB4: Prays Nanak, I meditate on the Lord's lotus feet; the Lord is the Lover of His devotees; this is His natural way. ||4||3||6||
Prays Nanak, meditate on the Lord's Feet, who has taken upon Himself the duty of loving His devotees.
B6ZQ: The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away.
Ever stable is the Spouse of the saints, He dies and departs not.
YKV5: She, whose home is blessed by her Husband Lord, enjoys Him forever.
She, in whose home is God, the Groom, ever enjoys Him.
MT09: God is eternal and immortal, forever young and immaculately pure.
Imperishable and Immortal is He, the Lord and is ever young and stainless.
1B3N: He is not far away, He is ever-present; the Lord and Master fills the ten directions, forever and ever.
The Lord is not distant and is ever present and He fills the ten directions for ever and aye.
VC3S: He is the Lord of souls, the source of salvation and wisdom. The Love of my Dear Beloved is pleasing to me.
He is the Lord of the soul, from whom proceed salvation and wisdom. To me is dear and pleasing the love of the Beloved.
VF6B: Nanak speaks what the Guru's Teachings have led him to know. The Husband Lord of the Saints is eternal; He does not die or go away. ||1||
Nanak utters what he has come to know from Guru's instruction. Eternal is the saints' Groom, who neither dies nor departs.
EKL5: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss.
She who has God for her Husband, enjoys great bliss.
XBEM: That soul-bride is happy, and her glory is perfect.
Happy is that wife and perfect becomes her glory.
8MYJ: She obtains honor, greatness and happiness, singing the Praise of the Lord. God, the Great Being, is always with her.
Singing God's praise, she attains, honour, greatness and happiness. He, the great Lord, is ever with her.
56W6: She attains total perfection and the nine treasures; her home lacks nothing. - everything is there.
She has all perfection and nine treasures and her home is wanting in nothing; it contains all things.
B0W4: Her speech is so sweet; she obeys her Beloved Lord; her marriage is permanent and everlasting.
Sweet is her speech and obeys she her Beloved and permanent becomes her married status.
LW6Q: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: One who has the Lord as her Husband enjoys great bliss. ||2||
Nanak says, what he has come to know through the Guru's teaching. She who has Lord for her spouse, enjoys great happiness.
TZ8Q: Come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints.
Come, O mate, to the saints and let us apply ourselves to their service.
NTRB: Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and so renounce our self-conceit.
Let us grind their corn, wash their feet and shed our self-conceit.
FBLM: Let us shed our egos, and our troubles shall be removed; let us not display ourselves.
Let us shed our ego and display not ourselves. Thus is our trouble removed.
RNPM: Let us take to His Sanctuary and obey Him, and be happy with whatever He does.
Let us grasp Guru's protection, obey him and be happy with whatever he does.
0E0U: Let us become the slaves of His slaves, and shed our sadness, and with our palms pressed together, remain wakeful day and night.
Let us perform the service of God's slave, dispel care, be wakeful, and, day and night, stand before him with joined hands.
VYNK: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings; come, O my companions, let us dedicate ourselves to serving the Saints. ||3||
Nanak states, whatever he has come to know from Guru's instruction. Come to the saint, O mate, and let us apply ourselves to his service.
17C8: One who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service.
He, who has good destiny recorded on his forehead, him the Lord yokes to his service.
WCJD: One who attains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, has his desires fulfilled.
He, who has obtained the society of saints, his desire is fulfilled.
Q83S: In the Saadh Sangat, immerse yourself in the Love of the Lord; remember the Lord of the Universe in meditation.
In the society of saints, man is absorbed in God's love and takes to Lord's meditation.
YGXQ: Doubt, emotional attachment, sin and duality - he renounces them all.
Doubt, worldly love and sin of duality, he abandons all.
63LT: Peace, poise and tranquility fill his mind, and he sings the Lord's Glorious Praises with joy and delight.
Peace, poise and sublime faith dwell in his mind, and with joy and delight he sings God's praise.
9PYQ: Nanak chants what he knows through the Guru's Teachings: one who has such good destiny written upon his forehead, dedicates himself to His service. ||4||4||7||
Nanak utters what he has come to know from Guru's teaching. He alone applies himself to service, on whose forehead such destiny is written.
G28U: If you chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Messenger of Death will have nothing to say to you.
Meditating on the Lord God's Name. Death's courier says nothing to the mortal.
FW29: O Nanak, the mind and body will be at peace, and in the end, you shall merge with the Lord of the world. ||1||
Nanak, his soul and body are at peace and in the end, he meets the World-Cherisher.
SCCT: Let me join the Society of the Saints - save me, Lord!
May I meet the society of saints, from where rescue me, O my Master.
F0AT: With my palms pressed together, I offer my prayer: give me Your Name, O Lord, Har, Har.
With clasped hands I make supplication before You, O Lord Master, to grant me Your Name.
EV0S: I beg for the Lord's Name, and fall at His feet; I renounce my self-conceit, by Your kindness.
By Yours grace, O Lord, I ask for Your Name, fall at Yours feet and shed my self-conceit.
J5BW: I shall not wander anywhere else, but take to Your Sanctuary. O God, embodiment of mercy, have mercy on me.
O Lord, the embodiment of compassion, take pity on me, that I may remain in Your refuge and wander not elsewhere.
TUX3: O all-powerful, indescribable, infinite and immaculate Lord Master, listen to this, my prayer.
O Omnipotent, Ineffable, Infinite and Immaculate Lord, hear You this supplication of mine.

83D2: I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom, worthless, destitute and vile.
I am a sinner, devoid of wisdom meritless, destitute and vile.
JJAV: I am deceitful, hard-hearted, lowly and entangled in the mud of emotional attachment.
I am stupid, stone-hearted, of low caste and entangled in the mud of worldly love.
Y3ES: I am stuck in the filth of doubt and egotistical actions, and I try not to think of death.
I am stuck in the filth of doubt and acts of egotism and egoism, and I am ignoring death.
55Y2: In ignorance, I cling to the pleasures of woman and the joys of Maya.
Through spiritual ignorance I am clung to the pleasure of woman and joy of mammon.
PQMT: My youth is wasting away, old age is approaching, and Death, my companion, is counting my days.
My youth is wearing off, old age is progressing and the death, my companion, is counting my days.
NBQW: Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, Lord; please preserve me, the lowly one, in the Sanctuary of the Holy. ||2||
Prays Nanak, my hope is in You, O Lord. Keep lowly Nanak in the asylum of Your saints.
A8UG: I have wandered through countless incarnations, suffering terrible pain in these lives.
I have wandered through many births and have suffered great pangs in these existences.
BNAA: I am entangled in sweet pleasures and gold.
Deeming revelments and gold sweet, I have become entangled with them.
M1WD: After wandering around with such great loads of sin, I have come, after wandering through so many foreign lands.
I have come after wandering in existences with immense loads of sins and have roamed through many foreign lands.
ZPWX: Now, I have taken the protection of God, and I have found total peace in the Name of the Lord.
Now I have taken the protection of Lord, the Enemy of pride, and have found all comforts in God's Name.
196Y: God, my Beloved, is my protector; nothing was done, or will ever be done, by myself alone.
My Beloved Lord is my Saviour. By me nothing was or shall be done.
Y7MN: You saved those who only pretended to believe, so what doubts should Your true devotees have?
The nominal saints, the Lord has saved. What doubt should the real devotees have?
JNWK: By every means possible, listen to the Praises of the Lord with your ears.
By every possible means, listen you to the Lord God's praise with yours ears.
40C4: Listen with your ears to the Word of the Lord's Bani, the hymns of spiritual wisdom; thus you shall obtain the treasure in your mind.
Hearing with your ears the hymns of the Great Divine Guru, you shall obtain in your mind the Name treasure.
8N2W: Attuned to the Love of the Lord God, the Architect of Destiny, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Imbued with the love of Lord God, the Creator, sing you the praise of the Omnipresent Being.
RUNJ: The earth is the paper, the forest is the pen and the wind is the writer,
If the earth be the paper, the forests, the pen and the writer the wind,
LYA2: but still, the end of the endless Lord cannot be found. O Nanak, I have taken to the Sanctuary of His lotus feet. ||4||5||8||
the end of the Endless Lord cannot be found. Nanak, I have grasped the protection of His feet.
RDJU: The Primal Lord is the Lord God of all beings. I have taken to His Sanctuary.
The Fortunate Master is the Lord of Men, and His protection I have grasped.
NTTJ: My life has become fearless, and all my anxieties have been removed.
Fear-free has become my life and my anxiety is all removed.
WH1L: I know the Lord as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and close relative.
I look upon God as my mother, father, son, friend, well-wisher and dear relation.
CC0L: The Guru has led me to embrace Him; the Saints chant His Pure Praises.
The Guru forced me to meet and closely embrace Him, whose pure praise saints utter.
ZNX1: His Glorious Virtues are infinite, and His greatness is unlimited. His value cannot be described at all.
He has infinite virtues and limitless greatness and His worth cannot be told even a little.
8EBS: God is the One and only, the Unseen Lord and Master; O Nanak, I have grasped His protection. ||1||
The Lord Master is Unseen, One and Unique. His protection I, O Nanak, have grasped.
ZQNM: The world is a pool of nectar, when the Lord becomes our helper.
The world becomes a spring of Nectar, when the Lord Himself becomes the Helper.
955H: One who wears the necklace of the Lord's Name - his days of suffering are ended.
The garland of Lord's name around the neck and the days of poison of the man.
REHR: His state of doubt, attachment and sin is erased, and the cycle of reincarnation into the womb is totally ended.
His state of doubt, attachment and sins are effaced and his, again entering into womb is all ended.
1PAC: The ocean of fire becomes cool, when one grasps the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint.
Holding fast the saints' skirt, the ocean of fire is cooled.
KKU1: The Lord of the Universe, the Sustainer of the World, the merciful all-powerful Lord - the Holy Saints proclaim the victory of the Lord.
O saints, proclaim the victory of All-powerful and Merciful God, the Lord of universe and the Cherisher of the world.
1XZ5: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, in the perfect Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have obtained the supreme status. ||2||
Meditating on the Perfect Lord's Name, in the society the supreme rank.
DETH: Wherever I look, there I find the One Lord permeating and pervading all.
Wherever I behold, there I find the one Lord abiding with all.
MQ6W: In each and every heart, He Himself dwells, but how rare is that person who realizes this.
In every heart, the Lord Himself abides. Rare is the persons who realises this.
QW7R: The Lord is permeating and pervading the water, the land and the sky; He is contained in the ant and the elephant.
The Lord is fully filling the ocean, land sky and is equally contained in ant and an elephant.
NN1Y: In the beginning, in the middle and in the end, He exists. By Guru's Grace, He is known.
In the beginning, the end and the middle is He, the Lord. By Guru's grace is He known.
F282: God created the expanse of the universe, God created the play of the world. His humble servants call Him the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue.
The Lord Creator is pervading the world-play, and God's slaves call Him the Treasure of virtues.
MRB1: Meditate in remembrance on the Lord Master, the Searcher of hearts; O Nanak, He is the One, pervading and permeating all. ||3||
Meditate you on Lord, the Knower of hearts, O Nanak, as the One God is contained, all over.
019U: Day and night, become beauteous by remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Day and night become beauteous by remembering the God's Name.

CLP6: In love with the Lord's Lotus Feet, corruption and sin depart.
By love with Lord's louts feet, vice and sin depart.
U6MB: Pain, hunger and poverty run away, and the path is clearly revealed.
Pain, hunger and poverty flee away and the man sees the true path clearly.
FGBE: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is attuned to the Naam, and obtains the desires of the mind.
Joining the saints society, man is imbued with the Name and obtains his hearty boon.
3UBR: Beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, desires are fulfilled; all one's family and relatives are saved.
By beholding the sight of God, man's desire is fulfilled and his whole family and all the ancestors (associates) are saved.
DDFG: Day and night, he is in bliss, night and day, remembering the Lord in meditation, O Nanak. ||4||6||9||
Day and night, night and day, man remains in joy, O Nanak, by meditating on the Lord God.
QBMA: Aasaa, Fifth Mehl, Chhant, Seventh House:
RAYG: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
9HUB: It is the most sublime contemplation, to speak of the Lord of the Universe in the pure Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
To utter Lord's Name, in the immaculate society of saints, is a sublime deliberation.
M84M: O Nanak, never forget the Naam, even for a moment; bless me with Your Grace, Lord God! ||1||
O Fortunate Lord, show mercy to Nanak, that he may not forget Your Name, even for a moment.
KV5N: The night is wet with dew, and the stars twinkle in the heavens.
The night is wet with dew and the stars glitter;
23KN: The Saints remain wakeful; they are the Beloveds of my Lord.
the saintly persons, beloveds of my Lord, remain awake.
Y3HK: The Beloveds of the Lord remain ever wakeful, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night.
The lovers of the Omnipresent Lord ever remain wakeful, end night and day remember the Name.
Q5ZU: In their hearts, they meditate on the lotus feet of God; they do not forget Him, even for an instant.
In their mind they dwell upon God's louts feet and forget not the Lord even for an instant.
NWLN: They renounce their pride, emotional attachment and mental corruption, and burn away the pain of wickedness.
They shed their mind's sin, pride and worldly love, and burn the pain of wickedness.
CBAS: Prays Nanak, the Saints, the beloved servants of the Lord, remain ever wakeful. ||1||
Prays Nanak, the serfs of God, the dear saints, ever keep awake.
8KPZ: My bed is adorned in splendor.
My mind-couch has acquired splendid adornment.
9UFB: My mind is filled with bliss, since I heard that God is coming.
Within my mind, joy has sprung up since I heard that my Lord was approaching.
6DEC: Meeting God, the Lord and Master, I have entered the realm of peace; I am filled with joy and delight.
On meeting the Lord Master, I have entered the realm of peace and am filled with essence of joy and delight.
9MH8: He is joined to me, in my very fiber; my sorrows have departed, and my body, mind and soul are all rejuvenated.
The Lord clung to my bosom, my sorrows fled and my soul, mind and body, all bloomed afresh.
QUUQ: I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires, meditating on God; the day of my wedding is auspicious.
I have obtained my heart's desire by remembering the Lord. The time of my wedding, I account auspicious.
ZHVH: Prays Nanak, when I meet the Lord of excellence, I came to experience all pleasure and bliss. ||2||
Supplicates Nanak, when I met the Lord of excellence, I attained the essence of all the pleasures.
PMX4: I meet with my companions and say, "Show me the insignia of my Husband Lord."
My mates meet me and say, "Tell us the distinctive sign of your Spouse".
ZY10: I am filled with the sublime essence of His Love, and I do not know how to say anything.
I was so filled with the elixir of His love, that I could not say anything.
R45U: The Glorious Virtues of the Creator are profound, mysterious and infinite; even the Vedas cannot find His limits.
The attributes of the Creator are profound, mysterious and boundless. The Vedas know not His limit.
HTME: With loving devotion, I meditate on the Lord Master, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord forever.
With devotion and love I meditate on the Lord and ever sing God's praise.
UQ33: Filled with all virtues and spiritual wisdom, I have become pleasing to my God.
Being full of all virtues and sublime wisdom, I have become pleasing to my Master.
JBSK: Prays Nanak, imbued with the color of the Lord's Love, I am imperceptibly absorbed into Him. ||3||
Prays Nanak, I am imbued with the dye of Lord's love, and am easily absorbed in Him.
61MU: My peace and happiness increased; I rejoiced in the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and God Himself blessed me with His mercy.
My happiness and comfort increased, I rejoiced in God's Name and the Lord Himself bestowed mercy on me.
M8LH: I have grasped the Lord's feet, and remaining ever wakeful, I have met the Lord, the Creator.
I clung to God's Feet, and being ever wakeful, I met Lord, the Creator.
3ZQN: The appointed day came, and I attained peace and poise; all treasures are in the feet of God.
Auspicious days came and I attained poise. All the treasures are in Lord's Feet.
DBY5: Prays Nanak, the Lord's humble servants always seek the Sanctuary of the Lord and Master. ||4||1||10||
Supplicates Nanak, God's slaves ever seek Lord's asylum.
YHRU: Rise up and go forth, O traveller; why do you delay?
Get up and go, O traveler, why doest you make delay?
7PWC: Your allotted time is now complete - why are you engrossed in falsehood?
Yours appointed time is complete and why are you engrossed in falsehood?
10CA: You desire that which is false; deceived by Maya, you commit innumerable sins.
You covetest what is false and, because of the deceit of mammon, you committest numberless sins.
GJRT: Your body shall become a pile of dust; the Messenger of Death has spotted you, and will conquer you.
O wretched man, Death's myrmidon has sighted you, you shall be overcome by Death and your body shall be a heap of dust.

CSAU: Abandoning your wealth and youth, you will have to leave, without any food or clothing.
Abandoning wealth and youth, you shall depart and you shall be shorn of raiment and food.
0JTT: O Nanak, only your actions shall go with you; the consequences of your actions cannot be erased. ||1||
Nanak, yours actions shall go with you. The effects of actions cannot be effaced.
LG80: Like the deer, captured on a moon-lit night,
Lo, as a dear is ensnared on a moon-lit night,
QFEH: so does the constant commission of sins turn pleasure into pain.
so from pleasure and commission of sins ever results pain.
JNBB: The sins you have committed shall not leave you; placing the noose around your neck, they shall lead you away.
The sins you have committed shall leave you not. Putting a halter round the neck, they shall goad you away.
JL7Z: Beholding an illusion, you are deceived, and on your bed, you enjoy a false lover.
You are deceived by beholding an optical illusion and on your couch you enjoyest but a false lover.
0P61: You are intoxicated with greed, avarice and egotism; you are engrossed in self-conceit.
With greed, avarice and ago, you are intoxicated and in self-conceit you are engrossed.
R5DW: O Nanak, like the deer, you are being destroyed by your ignorance; your comings and goings shall never end. ||2||
Nanak, like the deer, you are destroyed, through ignorance, and cease not Yours comings and goings.
3CP0: The fly is caught in the sweet candy - how can it fly away?
The fly is caught in the sweets. How can it take flight?
09S1: The elephant has fallen into the pit - how can it escape?
When the elephant has fallen into a pit, how can it escape?
D5VP: It shall be so difficult to swim across, for one who does not remember the Lord and Master, even for an instant.
To swim across shall be difficult for her, who remembers not her Spouse even for an instant.
3RSL: His sufferings and punishments are beyond reckoning; he receives the consequences of his own actions.
Her sufferings, and punishments, are beyond reckoning and she obtains the fruit of her actions.
SKEZ: His secret deeds are exposed, and he is ruined here and hereafter.
The hidden deeds are laid bare and she is ruined here and hereafter.
4AHU: O Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotistical manmukh is defrauded. ||3||
Nanak, without the True Guru, the self-willed egotist is defrauded.
66GM: The Lord's slaves live by holding on to God's feet.
God's slaves live by clinging to Lord's Feet.
F5BW: The Lord and Master embraces those who seek His Sanctuary.
The Lord hugs to His bosom those who seek His protection.
62DP: He blesses them with power, wisdom, knowledge and meditation; He Himself inspires them to chant His Name.
God gives them power, intellect, gnosis and meditation, and He Himself makes them repeat His Name.
ZYF7: He Himself is the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and He Himself saves the world.
The Lord Himself is the society of saints and He himself savers the world.
TTJP: The Preserver preserves those whose actions are always pure.
The Preserver preserver those, whose acts are ever pure.
9M2Q: O Nanak, they never have to go to hell; the Lord's Saints are under the Lord's Protection. ||4||2||11||
Nanak, they never go to hell. God's saints are under God's protection.
2ASE: Be gone, O my laziness, that I may pray to the Lord.
Get away, O my sloth, that I may pray to my Lord.
1FYZ: I enjoy my Husband Lord, and look beautiful with my God.
I enjoy my spouse and look beauteous in Lord's company.
EQY6: I look beautiful in the Company of my Husband Lord; I enjoy my Lord Master day and night.
Beauteous I look in the company of my Groom, the Lord, and day and night I enjoy Him.
HTY2: I live by remembering God with each and every breath, beholding the Lord, and singing His Glorious Praises.
I live by remembering the Lord with every breath, and by seeing God and singing His Praise.
CLSP: The pain of separation has grown shy, for I have obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; His Ambrosial Glance of Grace has filled me with bliss.
Separation feels shy, for I have seen my spouse's sight and His ambrosial look has irrigated me.
E110: Prays Nanak, my desires are fulfilled; I have met the One I was seeking. ||1||
Prays Nanak, my desire is fulfilled, for I have met Him, whom I was looking for.
7Q9X: Run away, O sins; the Creator has entered my home.
Run away O you sins as my Creator has visited my home (heart).
C7JN: The demons within me have been burnt; the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me.
The demons within me are burnt as the Lord of the world is revealed to me.
C7G9: The Beloved Lord of the Universe, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I chant His Name.
Manifest to me is the Beloved Lord, the World Cherisher and in the society of saints I repeat His Name.
ZH5E: I have seen the Wondrous Lord; He showers His Ambrosial Nectar upon me, and by Guru's Grace, I know Him.
I have seen the wondrous Lord, He sprinkles Nectar on me and by Guru's grace I have known Him.
L8TT: My mind is at peace, resounding with the music of bliss; the Lord's limits cannot be found.
My soul is pacified and overjoyed. Lord's limit cannot be found.
R2P1: Prays Nanak, God brings us to union with Himself, in the poise of celestial peace. ||2||
Says Nanak, the man's union with the Lord, in peace and poise, is effected by the Lord.
6SZJ: They do not have to see hell, if they remember the Lord in meditation.
Man sees not the hell, by meditating on the Pervading God.
1WJ1: The Righteous Judge of Dharma applauds them, and the Messenger of Death runs away from them.
The Righteous Judge hails them and the Death's Couriers flee away.
KVZW: Dharmic faith, patience, peace and poise are obtained by vibrating upon the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
By pondering over God, in the saints guild, man attains faith, patience, poise and peace.
WVCN: Showering His Blessings, He saves those who renounce all attachments and egotism.
Showering His benediction, the Lord has delivered those who have abandoned all the worldly-love and self-hood.
XMLM: The Lord embraces us; the Guru unites us with Him. Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, we are satisfied.
The Guru unite them with the Lord. He hugs them to His bosom. Contemplating on their Lord they are sated.
224L: Prays Nanak, remembering the Lord and Master in meditation, all hopes are fulfilled. ||3||
Supplicates Nanak, by remembering the Lord, all the hopes are realised.
